description:
A managed channel of a Notify instance (`[[channels.managed]]`): its
policy, who may publish, subscribe and manage, where it forwards, what
it polls. Rendered into the instance's configuration; `Ready` once
every pod of the instance applied it. Deleting it archives the channel
in Notify (it becomes dynamic, its history kept) or deletes it with its
notifications, as the instance's `channels.onRemoved` says.

access.description:
Who holds which scopes. A `serviceAccount` names a service account
id of the same instance (a `NotifyServiceAccount`). At most 256.

items.description: One subject and the scopes it holds.

email.description:
One person, by their verified email; takes effect at their first
login.

oidcGroup.description: Everyone in this group of the identity provider.

oidcSub.description: One person, by their `sub` at the identity provider.

items.description: What a principal may do in a channel.

serviceAccount.description: A service account id of the instance.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: an access binding names exactly one of oidcGroup, oidcSub, email and serviceAccount

closeAfter.description:
Inactivity after which Notify closes an open notification
(revisions and acknowledgements count as activity); `"0"`:
publishers close their own. Unset: one week.

defaultTtl.description:
How long a notification is kept when its publisher says nothing
(`48h`, `30d`; `"0"`, for ever, needs the instance's
`retention.allowForever`). Unset: the instance's.

feeds.description: RSS, Atom and JSON feeds polled into the channel. At most 32.

items.description:
A feed Notify's leader polls, publishing each new item as `publisher`.
The first poll only records what is already there.

every.description: How often it is polled, from `5m` to `24h`. Notify: `30m`.

lang.description: The language of the "Open" label and the summary title.

maxPerPoll.description: The most new items one poll publishes, from 1 to 50. Notify: 10.

publisher.description:
The service account it publishes as: it must hold `publish` in this
channel's `access`.

url.description:
http(s), no `user:pass@`. Changing it makes another feed, which
primes again.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: a feed url appears once per channel

id.description:
Its id in Notify, unique on the instance, what publishers address:
unset, `metadata.name`. **Immutable**: another id is another
channel.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: id is immutable: delete the channel and create another

instanceRef.description:
The instance it belongs to: unset, the only one of this namespace.
An instance of another namespace must accept this one
(`objectSelector.namespaces`).

kind.description: The kind of instance a reference designates.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: namespace only applies to kind LocalInstance

maxTtl.description: The longest TTL a publisher may ask for; a longer one is clamped.

publishPerMin.description: The most notifications one principal may publish per minute.

publishers.description:
CI jobs that may publish here with their forge's OIDC token: a
trust policy scoped to this channel, taking priority over the
instance's `NotifyTrustPolicy`s.

items.description: A CI identity allowed to publish here.
What a principal may do in a channel.

sinks.description: Where every notification is also delivered. At most 16.

items.description: An outbound delivery of every notification of the channel.

address.description: `email`: where it goes, through the instance's `smtp` relay.

secretRef.description:
`webhook`: the secret each delivery is signed with, in a `Secret` of
the channel's namespace labelled `notify.weebo.io/credential:
"true"`. Mounted into the instance's pods, never written into its
configuration.

url.description:
`webhook`: where it posts, http(s), with no credentials in it (the
url is stored and logged): put them in `secretRef`.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: a webhook sink has a url and a secretRef (it signs every delivery), no address
an email sink has an address only; the relay is the instance's smtp
